== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>e3b539ff228a4f351616a1145848de7c92b7cade</code>.
